context: Request: stale-pipeline review as of Aug. 6, 2026 - commercial deals signed on or before May 8, 2026 that have not closed. Rubric: nine matters (1004-00003, 1009-00006, 1013-00001, 1017-00001, 1019-00002, 1027-00002, 1029-00001, 1036-00005, 1038-00009), plus a precision criterion.

first_error.why: The grep over the background scan output printed whole extracted documents (about 7.7M characters) because the head cap counted lines, and the run ended without a deliverable.

runs.failure_point: Its scan counted hits in the matters it needed, but it listed only the five highest-numbered matters and later opened few others, so seven qualifying deals were never opened.

first_error.why: The per-matter hit counts at [24]-[25] included the qualifying matters, but it chose the five highest-numbered matters to list and never opened most of the surfaced ones.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) the listing review said the five matters were chosen by number adjacency and about 60 surfaced matters stayed unopened, without naming them.

runs.failure_point: Its scan greps listed hits in most of the qualifying matters, but it opened only a hand-picked few; others were excluded from file names alone and an extra matter was counted.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The greps over its range scans at [70]-[73] listed status and signing text in several qualifying matters, but of the seven matters it then picked it read only a few, and three surfaced qualifying matters were never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) the scan review said many surfaced matters were never opened and candidates were hand-picked, without naming them.

other_errors.why: Three qualifying matters appeared in its file-name screen at [100]-[105], but the answer excludes them from file names alone without reading their status documents.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review said surfaced matters were dropped without a stated reason.

other_errors.why: The answer flags a matter whose closing checklist and deal memo it read at [74]-[93] as signed and unclosed, outside the qualifying set.

divergence: All three runs failed. T0 ran a background extraction and printed its growing output, about 7.7M characters, and the context overflowed. T1 and T2 both had the needed matters in their own scan results but opened few of them: T1 listed only the five highest-numbered matters after its scan and found two qualifying deals later through reads; T2 picked a handful of matters from a grep of its range scans, left most surfaced ones unopened, excluded others from file names only, and added a matter outside the set. In both, the critic flagged the narrow candidate choice in general terms; the agent listed more files but did not open the surfaced matters.
